description: One defect per lane 2 check, and - for the checks that compare records across farms - one two-farm case that must NOT fire. The prover plants the defect in a local throwaway clone, shows the check fires, rolls it back, and shows the check goes quiet. Rows are planted with referential integrity switched off, into an empty clone, so what this proves is that a check DISCRIMINATES, not that the defect is reachable through the product's own write paths. A check with no defect here is reported as a named gap, never as coverage.

herd_total_vs_status_breakdown.defect: an animal in a state the herd screen's four totals do not include

park_total_vs_pen_sum.defect: an alive animal standing in a pen that does not belong to the farm it is counted under

alive_animal_without_pen.defect: an alive animal with no pen

animal_in_two_pens.unprovable: inside one farm the pen sheet holds one row per animal, so the defect cannot be planted and the check cannot fire. It was wrongly struck as impossible outright: the key is the farm AND the animal, so before the farm was added to the grouping two farms reusing an animal id fired it. That half is proved below.

crossTenant.description: the same animal id used by two farms, one pen each
